scenes.head: 外帶餐點怎麼保存？
scenes.say: 外帶餐點怎麼保存最安心？記住這幾個重點。
scenes.veo: Office worker carrying a takeaway bag through a bright office lobby, walking toward the camera.

scenes.head: 儘快食用
scenes.say: 第一，熟食最好儘快食用，在室溫下放置，不要超過兩小時。
scenes.veo: Close-up of a takeaway meal box on an office desk next to a desk clock, soft afternoon light.

scenes.head: 天氣炎熱更要注意
scenes.say: 第二，天氣炎熱、氣溫超過攝氏三十二度時，室溫放置不要超過一小時。
scenes.veo: Hot summer street scene with heat shimmer, a person holding a takeaway bag under bright sun.

scenes.head: 冷藏 7°C 以下
scenes.say: 第三，暫時吃不完的餐點，請儘快放進攝氏七度以下的冰箱冷藏。
scenes.veo: Hand placing a sealed food container into a clean home refrigerator, fridge light on.

scenes.head: 分小份、用淺盒
scenes.say: 第四，大份量的食物，分成小份、裝在淺的盒子裡，降溫會更快。
scenes.veo: Portioning a large amount of food into several shallow glass containers on a kitchen counter.

scenes.head: 復熱要熱透
scenes.say: 第五，再次食用前要徹底加熱，讓中心溫度達到攝氏七十四度以上，整份均勻熱透。
scenes.veo: Food thermometer inserted into the center of a steaming reheated dish, digital display glowing.

scenes.head: 只復熱一次
scenes.say: 第六，復熱過的食物，建議一次吃完，不要反覆冷藏、反覆加熱。
scenes.veo: A person enjoying a freshly reheated meal at a dining table, finishing the bowl.

scenes.head: 生熟分開放
scenes.say: 第七，冰箱裡生食放下層、熟食放上層，避免生食汁液滴到熟食上。
scenes.veo: Organized refrigerator interior: cooked food containers on upper shelf, raw meat in a sealed tray on the bottom shelf.

scenes.head: 有疑慮，就別吃
scenes.say: 最後，食物如果有異味、變色或黏液，請不要食用。資料參考食藥署與美國農業部。
scenes.veo: Person sniffing a food container with a doubtful expression and then closing the lid, neutral kitchen.

scenes.head: 品富餐飲
scenes.say: 安心帶走，美味不減。品富餐飲提醒你，好好吃飯。
scenes.veo: Warm closing shot of a takeaway bag with a meal box being handed over at a counter with a smile.
